primary_conclusion: The traced original36387 ordinary LOADS branch does not construct mass_weight or specific_covariant_p from the43 observed Vcirc/Verr values. It constructs annular masses from baryonic profiles, constructs source rotation from the previously solved even-metric radial slope, and then preserves the resulting covariant momentum as fixed Cauchy labels through the later finite geometry calculation. Observed velocity/error fields are used in separate final readout comparisons.
scope_and_remaining_premises: A new43 readout is conditional on these empirical baryonic profiles, declared fixed calibrations, prepared native/metric state and fixed model-generated matter momentum labels. It is not a refit of the43 velocity residual by this ordinary source constructor.

Holding model-generated p_phi is different from supplying observed p_phi as Cauchy input; if an alternate source branch explicitly used observed momenta, that would require a separate declaration and would narrow any blind-prediction claim. That alternate branch was not found here.

The saved matter rotation was derived from an earlier leading conformal circular branch and later held through odd/full metric and finite trials. This does not establish fresh ordinary Euler equilibrium, matter momentum evolution, finite thickness, junction/history or stability at a changed metric.

No claim is made that all historical source choices, background calibration or branch selection are statistically independent of every observation. This audit addresses the actual ordinary mass/momentum dataflow and its observed43 velocity/error selectors.
